#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;
const int MAXN = 1100000;

long long p, K;
bool vis[MAXN];

long long modPow(long long base, long long exp) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= MOD;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    cin >> p >> K;
    
    if (K == 0) {
        cout << modPow(p, p - 1) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    if (K == 1) {
        cout << modPow(p, p) << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    
    int cycles = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (vis[i]) continue;
        int cycleLength = 0;
        long long current = i;
        while (!vis[current]) {
            vis[current] = true;
            current = (current * K) % p;
            ++cycleLength;
        }
        if (cycleLength > 1) ++cycles;
    }
    
    cout << modPow(p, cycles) << endl;
    return 0;
}
